_comment: AssetExplorer UDF api_name -> friendly column-label map for one Vodacom Tanzania instance. Complete (all 34 asset UDFs): derived from the instance's AssetExplorer report definition (its UDF_CHAR1..24 / UDF_DATE1..10 slots) and cross-checked by correlating a report export against the adapter's AE001 pull. UDF labels are deployment-specific — copy and adjust for your own instance. Point AE_UDF_LABELS at this file (AE_UDF_LABELS=@config/assetexplorer_udf_labels.example.json) or paste the JSON inline; the adapter also tries to read these labels from AssetExplorer's field metadata automatically.
